summary: Assign Store-scoped saved Catalog photos to variants and resolve the selected offering's photo with the general item photo as fallback.
noAssistantImpact: The existing catalog.photos.replace operation gains optional image assignment metadata for merchant editors. Assistant Catalog creation still uses general private asset IDs. No assistant capability or procedure access changes.

evidence.result: Approved option photos follow all offerings of their variant, legacy photos remain general, and unrelated variants' photos are omitted.
